look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson nineteen
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 5, lesson T19, what is scalping; a short trade is bracketed on a fictional chart; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: From reading to deciding
scenes.desc: The tools from T14–T18 line up; the question of how short-term traders use them, and what it costs.

scenes.name: Scalping
scenes.desc: Scalping defined: small moves, trades of seconds to minutes; a stall making many small sales on thin margins.

scenes.name: A short trade
scenes.desc: A fictional 15-minute chart: two observations (a zone that holds, a thin-volume spike); a demo long 60,000 to 60,120 over 4 minutes.

scenes.name: The costs
scenes.desc: 0.1 BTC (6,000 USDT): gross 12.00, fees 3.00 + 3.01, net 5.99; a losing scalp: about −12.00.

scenes.name: Trade frequency
scenes.desc: Twenty round trips at about 6 USDT in fees each: about 120 USDT, win or lose.

scenes.name: Execution quality
scenes.desc: Slipping 10 USDT in and 10 out shrinks a 120 move to 100, before fees.

scenes.name: Scalping vs holding longer
scenes.desc: Minutes and many trades vs days and few trades; neither is safe.

scenes.name: XORA's 10–15 minutes
scenes.desc: XORA's 10–15 minute analysis horizon is context: not a holding rule, not a prediction window.

scenes.name: When not to trade
scenes.desc: Six situations stamped NO_TRADE: thin markets, news spikes, fees above the move, no reason, no stop, tired or chasing.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause: a 60 USDT expected move vs 0.10% round-trip fees at 60,000 (60 USDT). NO_TRADE.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Not easy money, fees and small losses add up, fast mistakes, leverage, demo first, NO_TRADE allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question to check yourself.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T20, evaluating an entry opportunity.
